request: Build a small Jac web app for asking questions about uploaded text documents. Documents are split into overlapping chunks; a question retrieves the best-matching chunks by keyword overlap and asks the model, which answers with the ids of the chunks it used. Documents can be deleted.
acceptance: A 1000-character document with chunk size 400 and overlap 100 gives exactly 3 chunks, and neighbouring chunks share 100 characters.
A question that matches no chunk returns 'not found in documents' without calling the model.
Every cited chunk id is one of the retrieved chunks; a deleted document's chunks are never retrieved.
constraints: Use Jac 0.36.1 and a fullstack Jac app.
Call the model through byLLM (`by llm`); tests use MockLLM with scripted outputs and never call a real model or the network.

source.note: Requirements written in English from the project's feature description; no code or text copied. Only one feature slice is reproduced.
